scenarios.name: Navigate backward through the new-project wizard

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with `fixtures/cad/project-dialog-native/WizardProject.opj` as its first project
the user opens Projects from the template chooser and chooses New
the new single-user project wizard is on its project-type page
the project-file page displays the project name and workspace folder
the Select Libraries page is displayed
its project name and workspace folder remain displayed
New Single User Project remains selected
the wizard closes and the Projects dialog is displayed
